audit_items.proof_trace: The proposer lookahead is computed after electra.ProcessEpoch completes, which includes ProcessRegistryUpdates that modifies validator activation epochs. The active validator set for epoch N+MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD+1 reflects post-processing state (including newly activated validators), while the property may expect pre-processing state. This creates a timing discrepancy where the randomness seed (derived from pre-processing RANDAO) and validator set (post-processing activations) come from different state snapshots.
